summary.intent: Continue phase 43 (feat/fuse-write-durability) by pulling latest commits, running a CodeRabbit CLI review, verifying all 8 critical findings (CR-01–CR-08) from an existing review against current code, fixing confirmed residuals, running a /simplify pass, and capturing deferred refactors as tracked todos.
summary.outcome: All 8 criticals resolved in code: CR-03 (TEE-wrapped key written into user-key journal field) fixed in all 8 wrap sites across fuser and winfsp paths; CR-04 (mutations before journal fsync) fixed via mutation deferral on both platforms. Three CodeRabbit cleanups applied, review docs reconciled, /simplify pass applied 3 safe wins. Two commits landed (fix(43) 341252d74, refactor(43) a1ec69f1b). Six deferred refactor/perf items captured as GSD todos and pushed.

repo: Phase 43 maps to branch feat/fuse-write-durability and directory .planning/phases/43-fuse-write-durability/

The codebase has two parallel FUSE implementation paths: fuser (macOS/Linux in crates/fuse/src/) and winfsp (Windows in crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/); winfsp cannot be compiled locally on macOS and is only verified by CI

Journal entries must store user-ECIES-wrapped IPNS keys; encrypted_ipns_for_tee holds the TEE-wrapped key and must never be written to the journal user-key field — mixing them causes replay to fail silently
crates/sdk has no dirs dependency; adding it requires a deliberate crate-dependency decision, not just a cleanup
The sync daemon and the FUSE mount must use the exact same journal directory path or entries will be missed — currently triplicated as a literal string in three files (CR-07 footgun)
CodeRabbit CLI can be scoped to a specific merge-base commit to review only branch changes
43-REVIEW.md and 43-08-SUMMARY.md can get out of sync; CodeRabbit flagged 43-08-SUMMARY.md claiming 'Self-Check: PASSED' while 43-REVIEW.md listed 8 unresolved criticals
Commits require 1Password SSH signing; 1Password can wedge mid-session with 'failed to fill whole buffer' requiring a full app restart

code.finding: CR-03 residual: error fallback in mkdir journal write used encrypted_ipns_for_tee (TEE-wrapped) instead of an empty string, silently journaling the wrong key type into the user-key field; fixed to warn+park
CR-03 residual: same TEE-key fallback pattern in the fuser mkdir path; fixed to warn and journal String::new() so replay parks instead of replaying with an un-unwrappable key
Parent IPNS key wrap failure was swallowed via .ok() producing an empty key with no log; also carried a dead journal_entry_id field that was only let _-suppressed; both fixed

First-publish detection keys off e.to_lowercase().contains('not found') from coordinator.resolve_sequence — a reworded error message silently flips the branch; deferred todo to make resolve_sequence return Result<Option<u64>> or a typed NotFound variant

CR-04: inode.kind, pending_content, and queue_publish(parent) all mutated before the journal.put commit point; reordered so all three happen after a successful fsync, eliminating the need for rollback on failure

wrap_key called as cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key while the rest of the file uses cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key — cosmetically inconsistent (same fn via re-export) but a potential latent compile error if the winfsp path is ever built in isolation; normalized to ecies::wrap_key
sort_by_key for replay ordering duplicated the per-variant created_at_ms extraction inline; extracted JournalOp::created_at_ms() accessor and collapsed both sort_by_key calls to use it

workflow: Parallel verification agents (one per CR finding) efficiently cross-check multiple issues simultaneously without serializing context
/simplify and /code-review are distinct passes: /code-review hunts correctness bugs; /simplify only does reuse/efficiency/altitude quality improvements — running both is additive
When 1Password SSH signer returns exit 0 but 'fatal: failed to write commit object', the staged state is preserved and only the signing step needs retry; do not re-stage
cargo check on the fuser crate covers macOS/Linux edits; winfsp edits require manual logic review plus CI as the compilation gate
CodeRabbit can re-surface known issues from planning docs if those docs are included in the diff scope — useful as a cross-check but treat 'doc' findings as pointers to real code gaps

When deferring simplify findings, recording them as GSD todos in .planning/todos/pending/ with file paths and line references makes them actionable in future sessions without relying on commit body text

friction: 1Password SSH signer failed twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' / 'fatal: failed to write commit object'; both failures returned exit 0 from the wrapping command, masking the failure until HEAD was inspected manually
winfsp path cannot be compiled on macOS, requiring manual logic review and reliance on CI for compile verification — increases risk for Windows-path edits

The journal-dir helper refactor (deferred item #3) cannot be cleanly extracted without adding a new dirs dependency to crates/sdk, making what should be a trivial dedup a deliberate dependency decision
open_items: Consolidate ~150 lines of duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload+mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs — highest priority; paths have already started to drift; D-04/D-05 ordering is security-sensitive (todo: 2026-06-14-consolidate-fuser-and-winfsp-journal-write-paths.md)

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing/unwrappable journal IPNS keys with Option<String> uniformly plus a wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper — parent_ipns_key_hex uses sentinel while file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option, inconsistent within one struct (todo: 2026-06-14-replace-empty-string-journal-key-sentinel-with-option.md)

Extract shared journal-dir path constant + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES from the three sites in apps/desktop/src-tauri/ — sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same dir; requires dirs dependency decision in crates/sdk (todo: 2026-06-14-extract-shared-journal-dir-and-retries-helper.md)

Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract a shared cas_publish_parent helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70+40 lines of logic also present in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs; is_first_publish probe must stay outside (todo: 2026-06-14-reuse-publish-file-metadata-and-cas-publish-in-replay.md)

Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault with a HashMap<ipns_name, folder_key> — currently re-walks vault tree from root per replayed entry, causing super-linear mount-time replay latency when multiple entries share a parent (todo: 2026-06-14-memoize-resolve-folder-key-during-replay.md)

Replace e.to_lowercase().contains('not found') first-publish detection with a typed Result<Option<u64>> or NotFound variant from resolve_sequence — a reworded error silently flips the branch (todo: 2026-06-14-replace-not-found-string-match-with-typed-error.md)

CR-04 on winfsp is partial by design: Cleanup returns VOID so winfsp cannot signal errors to the OS; inode rollback was deliberately waived with a code comment — the phantom-publish risk on prepare failure is narrow but real and should be revisited
CI winfsp gate is the final verification for all Windows-path edits made this session (cannot compile locally on macOS)
